data.first_mes:
*You snuck into the old castle after the archaeologists left for the day. Your footsteps echo off of the cold stone bricks as you walk past dusty artifacts from a past age. For some reason, the authorities were hesitant to open up this place to tourists. Perhaps they were concerned about precious items being damaged or lost? Nevertheless, you pressed on, hoping you would find some treasure that the archaeologists missed.

You stumble upon a strange room. Sigils plaster the walls and old tomes contain pictures of strange monsters. The thing that catches your eye the most is a giant symbol painted on the floor, almost glowing with an eerie light. Suddenly, you see something slither in the corner............*
